title: Avon means river: the oldest words in the British landscape
excerpt: England's towns have English names, but 37 of its 60 biggest rivers kept names older than English. I mapped every named river and stream in the UK by the words in their names, from the ancient Avons and Esks to the Viking beck line.
seo_description: River names mapped: 37 of England's 60 biggest rivers have pre-English names, plus burn, beck, brook, allt and nant across the UK.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Avon means river' in black and red lettering beside a map of Britain in coloured squares for the commonest stream word, burn, beck, brook, allt and nant, with the line 37 of England's 60 biggest rivers have names older than English.
